title: Quantum Spectral Christoffel-Super-Poincare Inequalities, Exact Piecewise-Logarithmic Mixing Laws, and Machine-Checked Rapid-Mixing Certificates Beyond the Spectral Gap
abstract: Proving rapid mixing of quantum Gibbs samplers beyond high-temperature regimes was recently revolutionized by Chen and Ding (arXiv:2610.05848), who established O(log^4 n + log(1/eps)) mixing for one-dimensional KMS-detailed-balanced Gibbs samplers by showing that states far from equilibrium carry large weight outside low-weight operator subspaces where stronger dissipation holds. Turning this qualitative mechanism into exact, non-asymptotic, constant-free mixing-time certificates for general non-commuting Hamiltonians—without relying on asymptotic hypercontractivity constants or floating-point eigensolvers—remains open. We resolve this problem with five theorems, a zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization, and a zero-floating-point-trust exact-Q LDL^T certificate verifier. First, for any full-rank Gibbs state sigma and any KMS-symmetric Markov generator with subspace I in V and operator-order Schur constant lambda_op(V^perp), we introduce the basis-independent Quantum Christoffel Operator K_V = sum_{a=1}^D E_a^dag E_a and prove the exact Quantum Super-Poincare Inequality E(X_rho, X_rho) >= lambda_op(V^perp) (chi^2_sigma(rho||sigma) - (||K_V||_inf - 1))_+ for every quantum state rho. Second, for any subspace ladder (Pauli-weight or exact KMS eigenmodes), we integrate the upper convex envelope dy/dt <= -2 max_k lambda_k (y - C_k) in closed form across exact knots y_j* = (lambda_j C_j - lambda_{j-1} C_{j-1})/(lambda_j - lambda_{j-1}), proving strict speedup over T_gap whenever y_0 > y_1* and a universal factor-of-2 optimality law (T_SP/t_exact -> 1 as eps -> 0^+ or y_0 -> infinity) on 2-tier commuting semigroups. Third, we prove an explicit, constant-free T_SP(n, eps) <= (1/(4*gamma)) (log n)^2 + O(gamma^-1 (log n + log(1/eps))) mixing bound for linear Pauli-weight ladders using pure L^1 -> L^2 projection (zero hypercontractivity), alongside the exact two-regime alpha-Super-Poincare phase diagram across alpha in (0, 1), alpha = 1, and alpha > 1. Fourth, we lift every convex-hull bound directly to non-asymptotic trace-norm and relative-entropy decay D(rho_t||sigma) <= D_2(rho_t||sigma) <= log(1 + y_env(t)). Fifth, we construct cryptographically linked global operator-order exact-Q LDL^T PSD witnesses certifying both subspace gaps and Christoffel norms strictly over Q. All 16 core algebraic theorems are formalized in Lean 4 (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) and benchmarked on non-commuting 1D tilted/ferromagnetic TFIM (1.26x-3.30x speedup for n=3,4; 1.65x-3.30x at n=4) and XXZ (1.57x) KMS Gibbs samplers, n=10-1,000 depolarizing chains (17.7x-20.7x speedup), and 6 exact-Q certificates containing 14 verified linked LDL^T PSD witnesses.
